summary: Fixed mid-air jump buffer expiry, overshoot on closely spaced platforms, and narrow landing tolerances, while upgrading visuals with real directional shadows, island grass tufts, glowing gem halos, a propeller hat, and blinking eyes.

bugs.title: Jump buffer expires during mid-air approach
bugs.evidence: In step 2, jump=true was passed at t=12.8s while grounded, then in step 3 jump=true was passed while mid-air (y=1.52) with 0.13s buffer; if landing takes >0.13s the buffered jump silently drops or fires immediately on landing causing an uncontrolled instant bounce.

bugs.title: Weak air steering and close platform spacing cause overshoots
bugs.evidence: In step 3->4, the player landed on platform 40 and jumped toward 41, immediately overshooting it because air acceleration (28) is too sluggish to brake or redirect on tight turns and early platform gaps can be too small for full jump arcs.

bugs.title: Strict vertical and radial landing collision misses edge landings
bugs.evidence: Landing check requires prevY >= pl.y - 0.02 and radial distance < pl.r + 0.25, causing fast-moving or grazing approaches to slip past the platform edge.
